answer.says: Nishchay hai. Thank you, Masterji. The separation of the hot from the cold is a small but necessary distinction in the order of things.
answer.thought: Masterji’s gesture is a practical application of the concept of form: by isolating the samosa, he preserves its identity against the contamination of the common. I have eaten enough; the body is satisfied, and the air at twenty-one degrees is agreeable. It is time to move toward the gardens before the light fails entirely.
